data.description:
Sibling of cabc-7a98-d173-4d7c, found in its Phase-1 sibling sweep (E5): Jira DC transport.py::_paged_search (src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/transport.py:379-416) loops on startAt offsets with no stall guard. A server that ignores/repeats startAt (returns the same page) spins to the experiment harness cap (26 calls) instead of terminating loudly. Same defect class as cabc (cloud acli_graph cursor spin, fixed by ab7f in 30c522cde9) and fetcher._iter_pages (guarded since earlier). No stall coverage exists in DC transport held-out tests.

Proposed fix (from cabc RCA): add an offset-stall guard mirroring the RunawayPaginationError pattern — if a page advances startAt by 0 items or repeats the same offset, raise loudly within 2 calls rather than spinning/failing open.

RED oracle: startAt-ignoring stub in tests/.../test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py asserting loud self-termination within 2 calls.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] _paged_search raises a dedicated runaway/stall error when startAt does not advance
- [ ] Fail-open exception handling does not swallow the stall error (it must propagate)
- [ ] Held-out test with startAt-ignoring stub proves termination within 2 calls
- [ ] Existing DC pagination behavior for well-behaved servers unchanged
data.title: DC _paged_search lacks offset-stall guard (runaway pagination sibling)
